ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.definitions.CrossCurrencyCurveUpdateDefinition

Update an existing cross currency curve definition

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.curves._cross_currency_curves.definitions.CrossCurrencyCurveUpdateDefinition.

Syntax

CrossCurrencyCurveUpdateDefinition(
    id: str,
    *,
    main_constituent_asset_class: OptMainConstituentAssetClass = None,
    risk_type: OptRiskType = None,
    base_currency: OptStr = None,
    base_index_name: OptStr = None,
    definition_expiry_date: OptDateTime = None,
    is_fallback_for_fx_curve_definition: OptBool = None,
    is_non_deliverable: OptBool = None,
    name: OptStr = None,
    quoted_currency: OptStr = None,
    quoted_index_name: OptStr = None,
    source: OptStr = None,
) -> None

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
id str Yes The identifier of the cross currency definition.
main_constituent_asset_class OptMainConstituentAssetClass No None The asset class used to generate the zero coupon curve. the possible values are:
* fxforward * swap
risk_type OptRiskType No None The risk type to which the generated cross currency curve is sensitive. the possible value is: * 'crosscurrency'
base_currency OptStr No None The base currency in the fxcross currency pair. it is expressed in iso 4217 alphabetical format (e.g., 'eur').
base_index_name OptStr No None The name of the floating rate index (e.g., 'estr') applied to the base currency.
definition_expiry_date OptDateTime No None The date after which curvedefinitions can not be used. the value is expressed in iso 8601 format: yyyy-mm-dd (e.g., '2021-01-01').
is_fallback_for_fx_curve_definition OptBool No None The indicator used to define the fallback logic for the fx curve definition. the possible values are: * true: there's a fallback logic to use cross currency curve definition for fx curve definition, * false: there's no fallback logic to use cross currency curve definition for fx curve definition.
is_non_deliverable OptBool No None An indicator whether the instrument is non-deliverable: * true: the instrument is non-deliverable, * false: the instrument is not non-deliverable. the property can be used to retrieve cross currency definition for the adjusted interest rate curve.
name OptStr No None The fxcross currency pair applied to the reference or pivot currency. it is expressed in iso 4217 alphabetical format (e.g., 'eur usd fxcross').
quoted_currency OptStr No None The quoted currency in the fxcross currency pair. it is expressed in iso 4217 alphabetical format (e.g., 'usd').
quoted_index_name OptStr No None The name of the floating rate index (e.g., 'sofr') applied to the quoted currency.
source OptStr No None A user-defined string that is provided by the creator of a curve. curves created by refinitiv have the 'refinitiv' source.
